on_record.summary: Is listed as a partner of the gallery and among its long-term supporters.
Its Chartwell Collection has been on long-term loan at the gallery since 1997 (2,134 works). It has supported the North Terrace commissions since 2012 and Aotearoa Contemporary in 2024.
Rogers Communications gave two works by Christopher Pratt and William Perehudoff to the LOOK25 gala auction; they sold for $55,000.
Rogers Communications gave $25,000 or more in 2024, its third or more consecutive year.

The major supporter of the biennale since its first edition in 2018.
Two biennale venues belong to ThaiBev: the Queen Sirikit National Convention Centre, run by a ThaiBev subsidiary, and One Bangkok, developed by TCC Assets and Frasers Property.
Supported, with One Bangkok, the biennale's 2026 Venice show.

Mphasis granted MAP INR 10 crore over five years for accessibility: barrier-free building work and interiors, workshops for people with disabilities, accessible exhibitions and website, and an Inclusion Officer.
